definitions.gloss: texture; feel; the character of a material
definitions.explanation: The look and feel of a material such as cloth, paper, leather or pottery, especially the natural quality that gives it character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧{風合|ふうあ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧。
⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風合|ふうあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese paper has a distinctive texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い{込|こ}む→使い込む：07876_tsukaikomu⟧ほど⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風合|ふうあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}して→増す：02422_masu⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: The more you use it, the richer the leather's texture becomes and the more character it gains.

notes:
⟦{風|ふう}→風：30892_fuu⟧ (style, appearance) + ⟦{合|あ}い→合う：10466_au⟧ (blend). Common in descriptions of clothing, crafts and interior goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔|やわ}らかな{風合|ふうあ}い: a soft texture
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風合|ふうあ}い: a distinctive texture
- {風合|ふうあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧: the texture deepens (with use or age)
- ⟦{天然素材|てんねんそざい}→天然素材：25173_tennensozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風合|ふうあ}い: the feel of natural materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧: how something feels to the touch only; {風合|ふうあ}い covers both look and feel
- ⟦{質感|しつかん}→質感：18028_shitsukan⟧: texture in general, also for images and surfaces
